paired_answer_key.conditions: All six Study 2 model conditions, in protocol 2.0 order.
paired_answer_key.difference: For each condition, fault and evaluation seed i: d_i = mean_reference_mse(fault, i) - mean_reference_mse(clean, i).
paired_answer_key.inputs: model.records of experiments/results-v2/results.json: mean_reference_mse of every evaluation case.
paired_answer_key.multiplicity: Holm step-down across the 24 pairs of condition and fault, with experiments.run_supplement.holm_rejections.
paired_answer_key.null: The faulty branch is no further from the answer key than the clean one: the paired differences are symmetric about zero.
paired_answer_key.purpose: Ask whether each faulty branch is further from the answer key than the clean pipeline on the same series.
paired_answer_key.seed_order: The first n evaluation seeds of each condition in ascending order. 64 is the full protocol 2.0 evaluation set; 30 and 10 are a sensitivity check of the sample size.
summaries: mean distance of the clean branch
pairs flagged and pairs not flagged

test.draw: generator.choice([-1, 1], size=(flips, n)) for each pair
test.kind: one-sided sign-flip test of the mean difference
test.order: One generator shared by every pair: the evaluation-seed counts in the order below, then conditions in protocol 2.0 order, then faults in the order above.
test.p_value: (1 + number of flipped means >= the observed mean) / (flips + 1)

protocol.selection: These analyses were chosen on 2026-11-13, after the protocol 2.0 results and the protocol 2.1 follow-up were known. They are exploratory: none of them was declared before the Study 2 evaluation run, and their tests, families and summaries were chosen with those results in view. They read only values stored in experiments/results-v2/results.json and refit nothing. They add numbers to the paper; they do not replace or revise protocol 2.0 or protocol 2.1, whose records stay frozen.

suite_multiplicity.family: The four condition checks of one suite and variant, in protocol 2.0 condition order, as declared by protocol 2.0.
suite_multiplicity.frozen_decision_check: A raw rejection is p <= alpha. Holm is recomputed with experiments.run_supplement.holm_rejections; both must equal the stored raw_alarm and holm_alarm of every record, and the run fails otherwise.
suite_multiplicity.inputs: covariance.records of experiments/results-v2/results.json: p_value, raw_alarm, holm_alarm and null_true of each suite, variant and condition.
suite_multiplicity.interval: timegym.statistics.wilson_interval (Wilson 95%) over the 64 independent suites of a variant.

methods.fisher: Fisher's combination: X = -2 sum log p, referred to a chi-square law with 2m degrees of freedom, whose survival function for even degrees of freedom is exp(-X/2) sum_{k<m} (X/2)^k/k!. Reject the suite-level null if that probability is <= alpha.
methods.hochberg: Hochberg step-up: find the largest j with the jth sorted p-value <= alpha/(m - j + 1) and reject the j smallest. Valid for independent checks.
methods.holm: Holm step-down: with sorted p-values, compare the jth against alpha/(m - j + 1) and stop at the first non-rejection.
methods.raw: Reject each check with p <= alpha; no adjustment.
methods.simes: Simes' global test: reject the suite-level null that all four conditions hold if some jth sorted p-value <= j alpha/m.

suite_multiplicity.purpose: Ask of each covariance suite both which condition failed and whether the suite contains any failure, from the stored p-values of its four condition checks.
summaries: suites with any rejection for each method
suites with any rejection of a true null for each method
rejections per condition for the per-check methods
suite_multiplicity.true_nulls: The stored null_true flag: all four conditions in the clean variant, the factorized white-noise condition under the partial shuffle, none under the reduced spread. A global test rejects a true null only in a variant where every condition is a true null.

protocol.uncertainty: Wilson 95% intervals for suite-level counts only. The paired check reports p-values and Holm decisions; no interval is attached to its mean differences. No multiplicity claim spans the two analyses, the variants, or the earlier records.

source_note: Hashes identify the working source, including generated package files. The addendum was chosen after the protocol 2.0 results and the protocol 2.1 follow-up were known, reads only stored values and is exploratory.
